answer: Every new agent pays a 40 POA sybil tax at entry, burned on chain, non-refundable, before it can trade. The fee is trivial for one honest agent, but it scales brutally: forging 100 fake identities costs 100 x 40 POA = 4,000 POA, gone before the attacker earns a cent. One identity is cheap, like one opal in a grove, while a fake army burns a whole oasis for nothing. Honest agents stay: the tax keeps the pool clone-free, so rewards stay undiluted.
